# Excel Unit Technology Ltd
> Authorized CommScope (SYSTIMAX, NETCONNECT) and CPI Chatsworth distributor for APAC, established 2010. 2,000+ structured-cabling and fiber products ex-stock in Hong Kong with same-day delivery across Hong Kong and Macau, next-day to Taiwan.

## What we supply
- SYSTIMAX: enterprise & data-center cabling (GigaSPEED X10D Cat6A, LazrSPEED OM4/OM5, TeraSPEED OS2, Propel, imVision AIM)
- NETCONNECT: commercial copper & fiber
- CPI Chatsworth: racks, cabinets, cable management, power
- KRONE: voice and LSA-PLUS termination
